subject.summary: Approximate stock 964 Carrera 2 coupe, reconstructed from photographs with a measured silhouette and inferred plan. No photographic artwork is embedded.

sources.title: Bring a Trailer seller b-brixton, 1993 stock Carrera 2: side photograph; minor perspective and wide-angle distortion remain
Inferred dimension-constrained plan measured drawing, based on elevated top/rear photograph IMG_4047; perspective-corrected bilateral estimate, not literal photo pixels
Dimension-constrained front elevation drawing inferred from full front and three-quarter photographs; shape approximate

facts.note: Chosen stock coupe interpretation of generation requested.

identity.feature: Classic short-wheelbase 911 fastback, narrow roof and voluptuous fenders
Two upright circular headlights flanking the long low bonnet
964 flush integrated bumpers with low front slots and full-width rear light ribbon
Retractable slatted engine-deck spoiler, not a Turbo whale tail
Cup mirrors and five-spoke road wheels
